term: selected-world actual-part existence and explicit causal actuality/nonoverlap policies
definition: ActualPartsExistAt says ExistsAt w x and p ≤ x imply ExistsAt w p. ActualNoNecessaryPartsHaveCausesAt says ExistsAt w x and NoNecessaryPartsAt m w x imply some c with m.Causes w c x. CausesHaveActualEndpointsAt says a Causes edge at w implies existence of both endpoints at w. CauseEffectNonoverlapAt says that same edge excludes existing common-part Overlap of its endpoints. The primitive Ontic cause relation and supplied fixed partial order are unchanged.
note: These are independently OPEN restrictions, not new causal/grounding relations or truths by their names. They do not infer productivity, complete explanation, autonomy, necessitation, transitivity, well-foundedness or causal exercise from labels. Actual-part existence is local to w and does not supply the L1 modal downward/persistence premise. No wholly-contingent sum/example/physical process is manufactured to establish joint adequacy. Strong rivals include overlapping/constitutive causation, brute no-necessary-parts actual roots, rejection of selected actual fusion, and different mereological/actualist domains; none is refuted merely by this conditional encoding. C1’s effect-actuality component and Fusion’s no-extra-parts component are retained but unused here, so no minimality is asserted. Source C1–3/A4 applicability and generalization require independent reading/defense; no source bare statement is aliased.
